investigations.name: full-corpus-reproduction
investigations.description: This is the full-corpus reproduction run. The batch-compare-biomodels composite fetches each model's SBML, parses every SED-ML simulation, runs each engine over all jobs, and reports all-pairs nRMSE per (model, SED-ML doc). Executed over the whole corpus with viva_biomodels.ray_runner (one Ray task per model, crash-isolated). The result — 1008 models, up to five engines each, 14.7M rows — is committed at datasets/corpus_all_engines/ (a sorted tidy parquet + a compact per-model index.json) and served to the corpus explorer (Analyses tab) as one JSON per model for lazy, model-by-model browsing.
investigations.title: Full BioModels reproduction across all simulators (1008 models × 5 engines)
investigations.objective: Across the entire BioModels corpus, do independent simulators (COPASI, Tellurium, simbio, AMICI, PySCeS) reproduce the same trajectories, and where do they diverge?
investigations.claim: Running the full BioModels corpus through the batch-compare-biomodels composite under up to five independent ODE engines reproduces 1008 models (14.7M timecourse rows) at corpus scale: 306 models are covered by all five engines and 725 by four or more. This study establishes COVERAGE — how broadly each model is cross-run and that the per-model, per-engine trajectories are committed and browsable model-by-model in the corpus explorer. Scored trajectory AGREEMENT against the BioSimulators reference is measured in the sibling repeat-matching study (currently on the BIOMD1-3 validation subset), not quantified corpus-wide here.

investigations.name: repeat-matching
investigations.description: The batch-compare-biomodels composite fetches each model's SBML, parses every SED-ML dataGenerator, runs each live engine, and scores two match kinds against the committed BioSimulators reference: repeat (live engine X vs reference X, same engine) and reproducibility (cross-engine, live A vs live B). Iteration 1 computed a partial observable set (17/48 reference observables missing on BIOMD1-2); iteration 2 extended the dataGenerator handling to full observable coverage. Results committed at studies/repeat-matching/results/ iter{1,2}_subset_match_summary.parquet.
investigations.title: Repeat- and reproducibility-matching vs the BioSimulators reference study
investigations.objective: Do the current cross-simulator BioModels runs reproduce the BioSimulators SED-ML reference results engine-for-engine (repeat matching), and where they diverge, can any previous cross-engine open questions be closed (reproducibility matching)?
investigations.claim: On the BIOMD1-3 validation subset, the live engines reproduce the BioSimulators SED-ML reference arm exactly wherever an observable is computed: after iteration 2 ("full observable coverage"), all 12 repeat arms (copasi/tellurium/amici/pysces × the models they cover) match the reference under numpy allclose with zero numerical mismatches; the only residual is coverage (2 reference observables in BIOMD3 are not yet computed by any engine). Cross-engine reproducibility is likewise exact where observables overlap (22/30 pairs exact; the 8 residuals are pysces computing 2/65 observables differently and simbio exposing a reduced 48-observable set). The dominant failure mode is observable coverage, not numerical divergence — confirming the study hypothesis.
